Beaches.title: Beaches in São Vicente
Beaches.description: Golden sand, calm bays and windy shores: find the right beach for your day on the island.
Beaches.listTitle: Where to Spend the Day by the Sea

card.opensInNewTab: opens in Google Maps in a new tab

descriptions.laginha-beach: Mindelo's most popular beach, with soft sand, nearby cafés and a relaxed local crowd.
descriptions.praia-grande: A long stretch of sand close to the city centre, easy to reach for a quick swim.
descriptions.baia-das-gatas: A sheltered bay with beach bars and the home of the island's famous music festival.
descriptions.salamansa: A wild, windy shore with black sand and some of the best conditions for wind sports.
descriptions.calhau: A quiet seaside village with a peaceful beach, far from the busier spots.
descriptions.sao-pedro: A wide beach near the airport with space to spread out and clear views over the sea.
